name: @ai-usage-widget/widget-macos
description: Native macOS WidgetKit widget (desktop / Notification Center). Reads the local collector over 127.0.0.1; no accounts, no network beyond loopback.

scripts.build: echo 'widget-macos: run `pnpm --filter @ai-usage-widget/widget-macos bundle` on macOS to build the .app'
scripts.bundle: xcodebuild -project AIUsageWidget.xcodeproj -scheme AIUsageWidget -configuration Release -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY=- build
